definitions.gloss: infarction; blockage of a blood vessel
definitions.explanation: A medical condition in which a blood vessel becomes blocked, cutting off blood supply to tissue and causing cell death. Most commonly encountered in the terms for heart attack and stroke.

examples.japanese: {心筋|しんきん}{梗塞|こうそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: He collapsed from a heart attack.

examples.japanese: {脳|のう}{梗塞|こうそく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早期|そうき}{発見|はっけん}→早期発見：16127_soukihakken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Early detection is important for cerebral infarction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{心筋|しんきん}{梗塞|こうそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こして→起こす：01234_okosu⟧⟦{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}→救急車：05077_kyuukyuusha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{運|はこ}ばれた→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{助|たす}かった→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather had a myocardial infarction and was taken by ambulance, but he was saved thanks to surgery.

notes:
The character {梗|こう} means 'to block' and {塞|そく} means 'to obstruct.' Together they describe the blockage of a blood vessel. Almost never used alone in everyday speech — it appears as part of compound medical terms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心筋|しんきん}{梗塞|こうそく}: myocardial infarction (heart attack)
- {脳|のう}{梗塞|こうそく}: cerebral infarction (stroke caused by blockage)
- {梗塞|こうそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to suffer an infarction
- ⟦{肺|はい}→肺：12334_hai⟧{梗塞|こうそく}: pulmonary infarction
- {梗塞|こうそく}{巣|そう}: infarcted area

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脳卒中|のうそっちゅう}→脳卒中：04647_nousocchuu⟧: stroke — general term covering both blockage ({脳|のう}{梗塞|こうそく}) and hemorrhage (⟦{脳|のう}→脳：03537_nou⟧⟦{出血|しゅっけつ}→出血：11735_shukketsu⟧)
- {血栓|けっせん}: blood clot; thrombus — the clot itself that may cause the blockage, not the resulting tissue damage
- ⟦{発作|ほっさ}→発作：15023_hossa⟧: attack; seizure — a general term for sudden onset of symptoms, not specific to vascular blockage

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
Several common words share the reading こうそく: ⟦{高速|こうそく}→高速：02749_kousoku⟧ (high speed), ⟦{拘束|こうそく}→拘束：02803_kousoku⟧ (restraint), ⟦{校則|こうそく}→校則：16056_kousoku⟧ (school rules). Context and kanji make the meaning clear.
